selection.name: mise (C03)
selection.role: Reproduce the chosen tool and configuration profile. Reviewed release: v2026.10.0. Agent sessions can invoke its install, exec and task CLIs for fresh destination-host checks.

basis.shows: Tagged documentation covers versioned tools, packages, dotfiles, repositories, services, environment modules, preview/status commands and secret inputs. Final tasks can perform fresh authentication checks; bootstrap history alone does not establish successful application recovery.
Documents mise.toml, mise.lock, callable tasks and a Linux/macOS installer.
Default-branch commit observed at 2026-10-02 03:21 UTC, within 90 days.
Release published 2026-10-02 01:42 UTC, still October 1 on the target host.
Inspected main-branch test run passed on April 6. This historical result does not validate October's bootstrap implementation.

selection.name: Restic (C06)
selection.role: Recover selected application files independently of tool reproduction. Back up consistent application data, omit authentication stores, recover the repository password separately, and validate restored applications on the destination.

basis.shows: Documents snapshot restoration into a chosen target, host/path selection, inclusion filters and dry runs. Its file recovery scope is broader than Litestream's SQLite replication.
Documents mise installation using restic@latest; the proposed command substitutes the reviewed stable version. Also documents Linux packages, macOS installation and verifiable official binaries.
July 5 release supplies Linux amd64 and macOS arm64 binaries. Release notes link fixes for reported backup, restore-selection and backend issues.
Default-branch commit dated September 25; both commit and latest release meet the 90-day currency criterion.
An October 1 pull-request test run passed. A separate Dependabot test run failed; neither result is a destination-host recovery evaluation.

not_selected.name: astral-sh/uv
not_selected.reason: Excellent Python lockfile, environment and tool reproduction, but narrower than the chosen general host profile and lacks application-state recovery in the reviewed documentation; active October 1 commit and release 0.12.22. Source: https://docs.astral.sh/uv/

not_selected.name: chezmoi
not_selected.reason: Strong machine-specific dotfile templates, preview/apply and separate secret-storage options, but this profile's configuration needs overlap mise bootstrap; no measured advantage established. Active September 28 commit and v2.73.0 release. Source: https://github.com/twpayne/chezmoi/blob/v2.73.0/assets/chezmoi.io/docs/user-guide/setup.md

not_selected.name: Determinate Nix installer
not_selected.reason: Explicit WSL2 x86_64 and macOS arm64 support, but installs the Nix substrate rather than supplying a complete application profile or state restore; its installation receipt serves uninstall. Active October 1 commit; v3.22.5 released September 17. Source: https://github.com/DeterminateSystems/nix-installer/blob/6613dfc41d1b306620048688b4c04adf8f7a51b8/README.md

not_selected.name: Devbox
not_selected.reason: Strong alternative for isolated, versioned development shells; mise covers more host configuration for this requirement, without demonstrated comparative superiority. Active September 28 commit; 0.18.4 released September 25. Source: https://www.jetify.com/docs/devbox/

not_selected.name: Litestream
not_selected.reason: Provides continuous SQLite replication and demonstrated restore/query instructions, but covers fewer application-state types than Restic; inspected nightly stability failures remain unexplained. Active September 21 commit; v0.5.17 released August 31. Sources: https://litestream.io/getting-started/ and https://github.com/benbjohnson/litestream/actions/runs/36808858975

layers.deciding_comparison: On the destination WSL2 Ubuntu x86_64 host, compare mise plus Restic against Devbox plus Restic using identical pinned tools, configuration and application data; compare chezmoi against mise's configuration restoration where templating or secret handling matters. Measure dependency reproducibility, setup failures, manual interventions, restoration time, file equality and database integrity. Establish native Claude Code/Codex sign-ins, scoped tool calls and useful tasks anew. Independently recover the backup password and application state while excluding authentication stores; require fresh successful application operations rather than historical receipts. Repeat the portable subset on macOS arm64. No GPU is needed.
evidence_gaps: Selection rests on complementary capability fit. No reviewed head-to-head evaluation establishes measured superiority, and the packet contains no comparisons.

All seven repositories are unarchived and have default-branch commits and releases within 90 days. Issue/PR totals were available, but response and resolution activity were not sampled consistently; totals were not used as merit scores.
Current mise bootstrap CI was not verified: the inspected test.yml endpoint returned successful April runs. Workflow listings establish test definitions, not passing October tests.
Restic CI included both a passing run and a failing Dependabot run. Litestream's recent nightly failures were inspected only as outcomes; their causes were not investigated.
Restic Linux amd64 and macOS arm64 assets were verified. Mise documents Linux/macOS support; explicit macOS arm64 artifacts and WSL2 test coverage were not verified.

Neither selected repository automatically enforces exclusion of authentication stores, fresh agent sign-ins, consistent live-database capture or independent key custody. Those remain acceptance conditions for the chosen profile.
Chezmoi and Devbox binary installation commands were not verified within the source budget. Mise's documented installer follows latest; a release-specific installer pin option was not verified.
Budget used: 30 GitHub API calls, 8 fetched pages and 0 web searches. No local project records or installed-tool observations informed the judgment.

Automatic approval review rejected the required ctx_fetch_and_index action because the MCP tool requires approval and this session's approval policy is never. Pages were retrieved directly instead; the requested ctx_fetch_and_index/ctx_search method could not be completed.
